title: potentilla alpestris var. baldensis
intro: Potentilla alpestris var. baldensis, commonly known as Alpine Cinquefoil, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family, characterized by its shrub-like growth habit and white to pinkish flowers. The Alpine Cinquefoil has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a potential treatment for various conditions such as wounds, digestive issues, and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla alpestris var. baldensis are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, and display antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
